annotations.message: Mimir Compactor {{ $labels.pod }} in {{ $labels.cluster }}/{{ $labels.namespace }} has not successfully cleaned up blocks in the last 6 hours.

expressions.A: {"model":{"datasource":{"type":"prometheus","uid":"mimir"},"expr":"# The \"last successful run\" metric is updated even if the compactor owns no tenants,\n# so this alert correctly doesn't fire if compactor has nothing to do.\n(time() - cortex_compactor_block_cleanup_last_successful_run_timestamp_seconds > 60 * 60 * 6)","instant":false,"intervalMs":60000,"maxDataPoints":43200,"range":true,"refId":"A"},"datasource_uid":"mimir","query_type":"","relative_time_range":{"from":"10m0s","to":"0s"}}
